plan.notes: Source: HSU official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index, file 26bsnatsci_veterinary.pdf - Natural Science, BS, Pre-Veterinary (2026-2027 Catalog), Version 2024/10/7. Header states the plan is 'a suggested program of courses' and 'does not substitute for the HSU catalog'. ENGL 10103 and ENGL 10203 require a grade of C or better; ENGL 10203 lists PR: ENG 1463, coded as plan-level external_prereqs (excluded from credit sums per standing rules). Genuine term-by-term sequence sums 15+16+14+14+16+14+15+15 = 119 - one credit short of the 120 hours the plan's own graduation requirements demand; the document's footnote states students are responsible for adding courses to meet the required hours, so the plan is recorded at its sequenced total of 119 rather than a rounded 120. All printed semester totals reconcile with the course rows. 'X or Y' choice slots use the first-listed code. ELECTIVE placeholders use code 'ELECTIVE' because the catalog names only the slot, not a course.
